title: Efficacy and Safety of Frontline Tislelizumab in Patients With de Novo Hodgkin Lymphoma Unsuitable for Standard Frontline Chemotherapy
official: Efficacy and Safety of Frontline Tislelizumab in Patients With de Novo Hodgkin Lymphoma Unsuitable for Standard Frontline Chemotherapy: a Phase II, Open-label Study
summary: This is a multicenter, prospective, non-randomized, open-label, phase 2 clinical study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of tislelizumab in patients with de novo Hodgkin Lymphoma deemed ineligible to frontline chemotherapy.
